{{Quote|The Galactic Republic was the Republic of legend, greater than distance or time.|Janyor|<ref name="SWP" />}}
The '''Galactic Republic''', also known as the '''Grand Republic''' or simply as the '''Republic''', was a [[Democracy|democratic]] [[Politics#Republic|federal union]] spread across [[light-year]]s of [[Realspace|space]]. Due in part to its long history, different names were used for bygone incarnations or eras of the Republic. The '''Old Republic''' and the '''first Galactic Republic''' were terms affixed to the original incarnation of the Republic that existed until its [[Fall of the Old Republic|fall]] to the [[Sith Empire]], which in turn fell in [[1032 BBY]], leading to the restoration of the Republic in that year. Later, the modern Republic that had been supplanted by the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]] was also referred to as the Old Republic. Additionally, the '''High Republic''' was a term used to describe the modern Republic during the [[High Republic Era|era]] in which it had reached the zenith of its power, which lasted from around [[500 BBY]] to around [[100 BBY]].

The Republic was originally founded many [[Millennium|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], approximately around [[25,000 BBY]] to [[20,000 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Senate]] governed the Republic under the [[Galactic Constitution]], and comprised thousands of [[senator]]s representing the Republic's member worlds. The [[Supreme Chancellor]] was the title of the head of the Republic, elected from ranks of the Senate to lead the government on [[Coruscant]]. An [[ecumenopolis]] or [[city]]-covered [[planet]], referred to as [[Imperial City|Galactic City]], Coruscant was the [[capital]] of the Republic and therefore the [[Imperial Senate Building|seat of the Senate]].

The Galactic Republic and its [[star system]]s shared sovereignty, and spanned a multiplicity of worlds from the [[Core Worlds]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories]], uniting a variety of [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]], [[human]] and [[alien]] alike, under [[Republic crest|one banner]]. As its power grew, the Republic fought many wars against various opponents such as [[Mandalorian]]s, the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]], the [[Nihil]], and several [[Sith Empire]]s. The [[Jedi]] Order, a [[Religion|religious]] group of [[Force-sensitive]]s dedicated to the [[light side of the Force]], was sworn to the service of the Senate, and as such the [[Jedi Knight]]s were hailed as the guardians of peace and justice within the Republic. [[Standard century|Centuries]] of conflict culminated in the [[fall of the Old Republic]], and the [[Jedi-Sith War|last war]] between the ancient Jedi and [[Sith]] concluded with the restoration and rise of the modern Galactic Republic, ushering in the [[Republic Era]] which was an age of peace that lasted for a thousand [[Standard year|years]]. The Republic's [[Timeline of galactic history|history]] was officially reset, and the ages before this event were merged into a collective whole known as the [[Old Republic-era]].

The Republic entered a period of decline after centuries of expansion and prosperity. Aided by the [[Rule of Two|resurgent]] [[Sith Lord]]s, the [[Separatist Crisis]] divided the galaxy between the Republic [[loyalist]]s and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic]] was organized under the leadership of [[Jedi General]]s who led the [[Republic Military]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. However, the conflict had been [[Grand Plan|orchestrated]] to allow Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]—the alter ego of [[Darth]] Sidious, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]—to control and deceive the Republic in a [[Dictatorship|dictatorial]] manner. With the [[Battle of Utapau|end]] of the war, Sidious initiated the [[Great Jedi Purge]] through [[Order 66]] and transformed the Republic into the Galactic Empire by [[Proclamation of the New Order|declaring]] himself [[Galactic Emperor]]. The [[Imperial Senate]] stood as the last remnant of the Old Republic until it was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|disbanded]] by the [[Emperor]] at the height of the [[Imperial Era]]. In the aftermath of the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was fully [[Declaration of a New Republic|reorganized]] into the [[New Republic]], restoring the Galactic Republic after a generation of [[Fascism|Imperial rule]].

==History==
===Birth of freedom===
{{Quote|For over a thousand generations the Jedi Knights were the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic. Before the dark times. Before the Empire.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:OldRepublicEmblem.svg|thumb|left|220px|The pre-modern Galactic Republic was referred to as the "Old Republic."]]
The original [[Galaxy|Galactic]] Republic was formed between approximately [[25,000 BBY]]<ref name="Altdate and Restoration date" /><ref name="Falcon 26" /> and [[20,000 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines" /> and rose to power by expanding across [[the galaxy]],<ref name="SWP" /> with several of its founding members being the [[planet]]s [[Alderaan]]<ref name="HC 1">{{HelmetCollectionCite|1|Databank A-Z}}</ref> and [[Chandrila]].<ref name="HC 9">{{HelmetCollectionCite|9|Databank A-Z}}</ref> Around [[20,019 BBY]], the [[Thisspiasian]] [[Blood Monarchy]] joined the Galactic Republic in its early formation.<ref name="Blood Court note">''[[Unlimited Power]]'' states that the [[Blood Monarch|Blood Court's]] hereditary line dated 20,000 [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[Imperial Era]] when it joined the Galactic Republic in its early formation.</ref> Multiple versions of the Republic existed throughout its extensive [[Timeline of galactic history|history]]; [[historian]]s referred to this pre-modern period as the "Old Republic,"<ref name="SWP" /> although the government's official name was the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Chaos Rising">''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising]]''</ref> The [[capital]] of the Old Republic was located on an [[ecumenopolis]] known as [[Coruscant]] and would remain there for thousands of [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="Capital">According to ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', [[Coruscant]] had been the [[capital]] of [[Galaxy|galactic]] [[politics]] for [[Millennium|millennia]]. However, it is stated in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] that the modern Galactic Republic, whose capital was Coruscant, was only founded about 1,000 [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Clone Wars]]. This implies that Coruscant was also the capital of the old Galactic Republic, which the televised episode "[[The Mandalore Plot]]" referred to as the Old Republic.</ref>

At one time, Coruscant's fellow [[city]]-world of [[Troithe]] rivaled it as the Republic's cosmopolitan center, holding a population in the billions. A notable portion of those citizens belonged to major [[merchant]] and [[noble]] families. However, Coruscant ultimately outpaced Troithe in industrial growth. As years passed, Troithe fell into decline.<ref name="Shadow Fall">''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref> At least five [[Millennium|millennia]] before the start of the [[Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="TSWB" /> a [[Jedi splinter group|rogue faction]] of [[Jedi]] broke away from the [[Jedi Order]], believing that practicing the [[dark side of the Force]] would benefit the furthering of Jedi power. This schism divided the Order on ideological grounds, igniting an event known as the [[Hundred-Year Darkness]], which, in turn, resulted in the formation of the [[Sith]].<ref name="Sith">{{SWE|groups|sith|Sith}}</ref> At one point, they managed to construct a [[Shrine in the Depths|dark shrine]] on Coruscant. The rogue faction was ultimately [[Sith war (Old Republic)|defeated]], and they were [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith war)|exiled]] from the Old Republic into uncharted [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref>

At some point, the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] was constructed over the Sith shrine in order to contain its dark energy.<ref name="Tarkin" /> Once it had established itself on Coruscant, the Jedi Order closely associated itself with the Old Republic, serving as guardians of the peace and justice for over a thousand generations.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Little did the Jedi know, the Sith had regrouped on the planet [[Moraband]].<ref name="Sith" />

Thousands of years before the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Corellian royalty]] sponsored exploration and colonization efforts that helped expand the frontiers of the Old Republic.<ref name="Official Guide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> [[Hyperspace]] travel would prove to be the key to the Republic's expansion beyond the [[Core Worlds]].<ref name="Light of the Jedi">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref>

===A clash of destinies in the galaxy===
{{Quote|The history of the Ascendancy is in these rooms, some of the pieces dating back to Chiss participation in the wars between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], to [[Ar'alani]]|<ref name="Chaos Rising" />}}
As the Old Republic spread its influence across the [[star]]s, it came into contact with various other powers, one of them being the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. Due to the fact that, at some point in its past, the Old Republic declared [[slavery]] illegal and expected other civilizations of the galaxy to comply, it took an aggressive stance against the [[Zygerrian]]s. The Zygerrian Empire, which was built upon slavery, refused to comply, forcing both the Old Republic and the Jedi to intervene. After joining together, the Old Republic and Jedi Order sent their [[Army|armies]] [[Jedi–Zygerrian conflict|against]] the empire after the Zygerrians refused. The Old Republic ultimately came out victorious, driving the practice of slave trading into the underworld, dismantling the empire, and confining what was left of its government to [[Zygerria]], the civilization's [[homeworld]].<ref name="Zygerrian Databank">{{Databank|zygerrian|Zygerrian}}</ref> Another one was the rogue [[Predori]] empire.<ref name="ALD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref>

[[File:GreatScourgeofMalachor-TotA1.png|thumb|right|250px|Destructive wars were fought between the Sith and the Jedi in the age of the Old Republic.]]
Eventually, the Sith would return in full strength, invading the Old Republic. From there, the dark Order would do battle with the Jedi and the Old Republic. This would lead to a series of conflicts between both groups that would go on for thousands of years until the Old Republic's ultimate collapse.<ref name="Sith" /> During one of the wars, the Jedi [[Great Scourge of Malachor|fought]] the [[Sith Empire]] on [[Malachor]], which proved to be one of the most devastating battles in the history of the Order.<ref name="Twilight of the Apprentice">{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}}</ref>

At some point, the Old Republic came into contact with the [[Mandalorian]] people. The warrior civilization began a series of unprovoked military [[Mandalorian crusades|campaigns]] against the Old Republic. Later on, after all-out [[Mandalorian-Jedi War|war]] erupted, the Jedi stepped in to defend the Republic.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> In the meantime, Republic and Jedi forces continued to wage war against the expanding Sith Empire. During these wars, both sides would construct massive [[superweapon]]s powered by large [[kyber crystal]]s capable of mass destruction.<ref name="The Big Bang">{{TCW|The Big Bang}}</ref><ref name="Death Star Superlaser">{{Databank|death-star-superlaser|Death Star Superlaser}}</ref>

The [[Middle Era of the Old Republic]] was one period of galactic history.<ref name="Guardians of the Whills">[[Guardians of the Whills (novel)|''Guardians of the Whills'']]</ref> The Galactic Republic also participated in the [[Sith Wars]], a series of conflicts against the Sith Empire and involving the [[Chiss Ascendancy]]. The Ascendancy encountered a number of [[alien]]s before retreating to their borders.<ref name="Chaos Rising" />

===Fall of the Old Republic===
{{Quote|This lightsaber was stolen from your Jedi Temple by my ancestors during the fall of the Old Republic.|Pre Vizsla, to Obi-Wan Kenobi, regarding the Darksaber|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />}}
[[File:Mandalore_mural.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Mandalorian Wars brought on the beginning of the Old Republic's downfall.]]
With the civilization of the Sith and the warrior culture of [[Mandalore]], and with their beliefs of continual warfare without regard to the Jedi mandate of protecting the weak, the Jedi Order continued to mobilize its forces in an effort to stop enemy incursions into Old Republic space.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" /><ref name="Sith" />

The power of the Sith Empire increased during the [[fall of the Old Republic]]. The Sith soon achieved near-dominance across the galaxy.<ref name="Episode III" /> It was also during this time that an ancestor of [[Pre Vizsla]],<ref name="Rebels Recon #3.14">{{RebelsRecon|EfCuHRbbTZk|#3.14: Inside "Warhead" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-warhead}}</ref> leader of the Mandalorian group [[Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars]], managed to steal the [[Darksaber]] from the Jedi [[Jedi temple|Temple]].<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />

At some point the galaxy entered a state known as the Dark Age. During this time, the [[Jedi-Sith War]] broke out. Early on in this conflict, the Old Republic capital world of Coruscant was taken over by the Sith during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Jedi-Sith War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. Later on in the war, the Sith were driven off the planet by the Jedi during the [[Liberation of Coruscant]].<ref name="SWP" />

===The fires of hope===
{{Quote|The Republic victory was so definitive that it reinvented itself, resettling its capital on Coruscant after a devastating ouster. History reset its chrono on this date, and from that moment, the modern Galactic Republic was born.|Janyor|<ref name="SWP" />}}
The Old Republic managed to regain some of its strength after its forces had reclaimed the capital, capable of going on the offensive.<ref name="SWP" /> The Jedi were strong enough to finally end its ancient war against the Mandalorian clans. A [[Annihilation|battle]] between both groups on the planet Mandalore left the planet ravaged and lifeless.<ref name="Gauntlet fighter">{{SWE|technology|gauntlet-fighter|Gauntlet fighter}}</ref> It was during this time too when the Sith were finally [[Defeat of the Sith|defeated]] in [[1032 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> The armies of the Old Republic<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref> and [[Jedi Knight]]s<ref name="Bane Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Darth Bane|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644161/2018-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-ACW-29-Darth-Bane}}</ref> were able to defeat the remaining Sith<ref name="Sacrifice" /> at the [[Mid Rim Territories]] [[planet]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Ruusan]]<ref name="Helmet Collection">{{HelmetCollectionCite|29|Databank A-Z}}</ref> by taking advantage of the infighting within the Order,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> which proved to be the Sith's undoing.<ref name="Helmet Collection" /> The Sith abandoned their traditional homeworld of Moraband after it was scarred by many wars,<ref name="datamora">{{Databank|moraband|Moraband}}</ref> and went into hiding.<ref name="Tarkin" /> Very few Sith remained by that point, and they ultimately destroyed themselves. Only one [[Sith Lord]] survived; [[Darth Bane]] reinvented the Sith by creating the [[Rule of Two]]. Henceforth, their ranks were limited to a [[Sith Master]] and a [[Sith apprentice]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />

[[File:Galactic_City.png|thumb|right|250px|The Old Republic was reborn as the modern Galactic Republic after millennia of warfare.]]
As the Old Republic fell apart as a result of its continuous wars, the Jedi Order finally believed itself victorious from its conflict with the Sith, who they believed to have been destroyed completely. Finally, with peace restored to the galaxy, the shattered Old Republic reorganized itself into the modern Galactic Republic,<ref name="SWP" /> which would usher in over one thousand years of stability in an epoch known as the [[Republic Era|Great Peace]].<ref name="Collapse">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref> The story of Old Republic [[Regent]] [[Hylemane Lightbringer]] and his supposed [[immortality]] would be remembered in history texts along with Old Republic music such as the [[Sestina of Imperator Vex]], which would continue to be sung even in the [[Standard month|months]] following the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

===Rise of democracy===
{{Quote|There hasn't been a full-scale war since the formation of the Republic.|Sio Bibble|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
[[File:Millennial_Celebration_Invitation.png|thumb|left|200px|The Great Peace of the Republic lasted for almost a thousand years.]]
The Old Republic was restored<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> in the form of the modern Galactic Republic<ref name="SWP" /> in 1032 BBY.<ref name="Altdate and Restoration date" /> After the Galactic Republic's reformation,<ref name="Zygerrian Databank" /> the Zygerrians would continue to hold a grudge against both the Republic and the Jedi Order for the destruction of their slave empire.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref><ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>

The modern Republic was a [[Democracy|democratic]] union that consisted of multiple [[star system]]s spread across the galaxy.<ref name="RepublicDB" /> With the exception of small-scale conflicts that the Jedi dealt with, the Republic Era was an age of peace and stability that lasted for over a [[millennium]].<ref name="SWP" /> This version of the Republic existed in a demilitarized state for most of its history;<ref name="Episode II" /> as such, the government relied on the [[Jedi Knight]]s, who upheld their mandate as the guardians of peace and justice.<ref name="JediDB">{{Databank|jedi-order|Jedi Order}}</ref>

The [[Four Sages of Dwartii]] were notable in influencing some of its earliest laws.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> As its governing body, the newly reorganized government established the [[Galactic Senate]], the members of which were elected to represent their systems. Coruscant was the galactic seat of power under the Republic,<ref name="RepublicDB" /> as it had been for thousands of years before the Republic's rebirth.<ref name="SWP" />

The Republic's head of state, the [[Supreme Chancellor]], was elected by and from the senators, in which the first in a long line of Chancellors<ref name="Tarkin" /> was [[Tarsus Valorum]],<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" /> a scion of the [[House Valorum]].<ref name="Tarkin" /><ref name="Episode I" /> Protecting the new democracy was the elite [[Senate Guard]], who could be seen patrolling the [[Federal District|Senate District]] and came to be seen as symbols of strength and unity, especially considering the fact that the military had been disbanded.<ref name="Tarkin" /><ref name="SWEsenateguard">{{SWE|groups|senateguard|Senate Guard}}</ref> In time, the Jedi Order, a noble order of protectors who could tap into the power of the Force, came to serve the Republic as guardians of peace and justice.<ref name="JediDB" /> With the lack of a standing army, the Republic came to rely on its peacekeeping [[Judicial Forces]], led by the Judicial Department as the ''de facto'' [[Law enforcement agency|law enforcement]] branch of the government. The Judicial Forces, members of which were simply known as [[Judicial]]s, trained at the [[Judicial Academy]] and came to serve in both ground and space forces, often led by Jedi [[Commander]]s to maintain peace throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Tarkin" />

===High Republic Era===
====A golden age====
{{Quote|We are all the Republic.|Lina Soh|<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />}}
[[File:High_Republic_symbol.svg|thumb|right|250px|The term "High Republic" referred to an era of prosperity and exploration between 500 BBY and 100 BBY.]]
With the galaxy at peace,<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> the [[High Republic Era]], which lasted from around [[500 BBY]] to around [[100 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> saw the Galactic Republic reach the pinnacle of its power, with its influence spreading to even the farthest and less settled regions of the galaxy:<ref name="HR Announcement">{{SWYouTube|xCat5fXRyyU|Star Wars: The High Republic | Announcement Trailer|sw_url=video/announce-trailer-star-wars-the-high-republic}}</ref> the Republic worked to expand into the Outer Rim, specifically a region<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> of the Rim<ref name="Into the Dark">''[[The High Republic: Into the Dark]]''</ref> known as the [[Galactic Frontier]].<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> The Jedi Order also became increasingly active in galactic affairs<ref name="Kylo 2">[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 2|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 2]]</ref> and helped the Republic's efforts. An [[Office of the Frontier]] was established.<ref name="Convergence">''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]''</ref> The Republic's expansion kicked off the [[Great Hyperspace Rush]] to find and map any yet to be discovered [[hyperspace route]]s,<ref name="Out of the Shadows">''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]''</ref> with [[Republic Pathfinder]]s working directly for the government<ref name="Galactic Tales Inheritance">{{InsiderCite|211|Galactic Tales: Inheritance}}</ref> as [[Outer Rim Exploration Team]]s.<ref name="Convergence" /> Private groups got involved in the hunt for new hyperspace routes as well, with the [[San Tekka clan]] and [[Graf family]] both taking advantage of the rush. The San Tekka clan's success in locating new routes and ensuing fortune from those discoveries were secretly a result of the Force-sensitive [[Mari San Tekka]], who had the special ability to locate and map out the routes herself.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

Beyond the mission to open up new hyperlanes<ref name="Pathfinders and Comms Teams">{{SWYouTube|series=Characters of Star Wars: The High Republic|text=Pathfinders and Comms Teams|video=AHqxuNVDEcI|sw_url=video/pathfinders-and-comms-teams-characters-of-the-high-republic}}</ref> by discovering<ref name="Out of the Shadows" /> and charting them,<ref name="Convergence" /> Republic Pathfinders were ordered to explore, help those they found, and, in what was a major part of their mission, establish a functioning communications network across the Outer Rim. While creating the network, Pathfinder teams often worked alongside comms teams in order to get in contact with the Republic at large while out in the Rim. However, the Pathfinders needed to establish the network one node at a time. While the Pathfinders knew the long-term effort would one day result in communications being as fast in the Rim as it was in the Core, [[Grint Rupar]] of [[Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven]] suspected the work would take generations. Nevertheless, Jedi [[Porter Engle]] dubbed it a noble effort that would change lives for the better. Members of the Jedi Order worked side-by-side with Pathfinders, traveling with them and helping in the Republic effort.<ref name="Blade 1">[[The High Republic — The Blade 1|''The High Republic — The Blade'' 1]]</ref> One Pathfinder team, while working on charting the hyperlanes near Sullust, discovered the volcanic planet [[Tunguray]] and evacuated its [[Tunguray (species)|people]] to safety on Coruscant.<ref name="Convergence" />

[[File:OrlenMolloKyongGreylark-TheChancellors.png|thumb|left|250px|Orlen Mollo and Kyong Greylark served as Co-Chancellors of the Galactic Republic.]]
By [[382 BBY]],<ref name="382 Date">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]'' to [[382 BBY]].</ref> leadership of the Republic was split between two chancellors, [[Orlen Mollo]] and [[Kyong Greylark]]. Elected and then re-elected together, their joint leadership<ref name="Convergence" /> as Co-Chancellors<ref name="BoJ">''[[The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha]]''</ref> helped in the Republic's outreach; while the more formal Greylark remained on Coruscant<ref name="The Chancellors">{{SWYouTube|series=Characters of Star Wars: The High Republic|text=The Chancellors|video=w54C6NHFasc|sw_url=video/the-chancellors-characters-of-the-high-republic}}</ref> with the Senate, Mollo traveled across the Outer Rim with his [[aide]]s and crew aboard the [[Alif-class Longbeam|''Alif''-class Longbeam]] ''[[Paxion]]'',<ref name="Convergence" /> adopting a hands on approach to governance<ref name="The Chancellors" /> to help with expansion and end problems. Having lived through conflict on Mon Cala, Mollo believed he better understood the Outer Rim but trusted in his Co-Chancellor, whom he believed saw the promise in the Outer Rim but not the finer details he could, all the same due to their shared vision: a truly united galaxy.<ref name="Convergence" />

[[Ambassador ship]]s like the ''Paxion'' were also provided with top-of-the-line [[protocol droid]]s, with the ''Paxion'' being given unit [[AR-K4]].<ref name="Convergence" /> With the Republic aided by the Jedi,<ref name="THR 1">[[The High Republic (2022) 1|''The High Republic'' (2022) 1]]</ref> the Republic and [[Togruta]]s engaged in a [[Republic-Togruta conflict|conflict]] in [[Togruta space]] that left tensions between both parties.<ref name="Rising Storm">''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''</ref> While Greylark believed the [[Eiram system|star system]] was not ready for their intervention, Mollo traveled to the planets of [[Eiram]] and [[E'ronoh]], which were home to a [[Eiram and E'ronoh War|war]] he hoped to finally put a stop to. At the same time, a team of Jedi—consisting of Master [[Char-Ryl-Roy]], Master [[Creighton Sun]], Knight [[Gella Nattai]], and Padawan [[Enya Keen]]—traveled into the system aboard the ''[[Valiant]]'' to provide aid to Eiram, only to collide with the ''Paxion'' amid a [[Skirmish in the Eiram system|skirmish]] that had secretly been orchestrated by the [[Path of the Open Hand]] cult under the control of "[[Elecia Zeveron|the Mother]]." Despite the rocky opening, Mollo and the Jedi began the peace process between both worlds' royal families aboard the ''Paxion'', although progress only truly started to be made when E'ronohi [[princess]] [[Xiri A'lbaran]] proposed to [[Eirami]] prince [[Phan-tu Zenn]], thereby setting the stage for a marriage alliance and an unlikely love story.<ref name="Convergence" />

Meanwhile on Coruscant, Greylark feared Mollo was making a play at a solo-chancellery ahead of the campaign season. In reality, Mollo simply wanted to be the one to bring peace to the system because of his own past surrounded by war. Deep down, Greylark did trust in her fellow Chancellor, but sent her controversial son [[Axel Greylark]] to represent [[Office of Chancellor Greylark|her office]] in the peace proceedings and report back to her. Axel's own dealings with the Path of the Open Hand nearly led to the destruction of the peace process after cult leader [[Elecia Zeveron]] demanded he bring her a [[Poison|toxin]] developed on Eiram. Amid the successful [[Wedding of Phan-tu Zenn and Xiri A'lbaran]] officiated by Mollo, Axel's desperation to prevent Zeveron from securing the toxin led to him destroying the [[deflector shield]]s around Eiram's capital of [[Erasmus Capital City|Erasmus]]. After Axel's arrest, the royals agreeing to destroy the toxin, and the formal beginning of the peace process, Mollo reminded his fellow Chancellor to trust him, to which Greylark admitted she did and she had simply wanted to trust her son as well.<ref name="Convergence" />

====Conflict with the Path====
{{Dialogue|Yoda|Speak to the Jedi Council soon, you should. We must explain the happenings on Dalna. All that went wrong.|Orlen Mollo|The communications errors. The machinations of the Path. All going back to the failed talks at Jedha. And beyond.|Kyong Greylark|But we must also speak to all the things that went right. We could not have defeated the Path without the Jedi.|Yoda|And the Jedi could not have defeated the Path without the help of our Republic allies.|Orlen Mollo|Yes. It is a lesson well learned, and a strength that the galaxy can draw upon, for centuries to come.|attr=Jedi Grand Master Yoda, Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo, and former Chancellor Kyong Greylark reflect on recent events|src=<ref name="Cataclysm">''[[The High Republic: Cataclysm]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Battleofjedhastatuefall.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic rushed to Jedha to shut down the battle spurred on by the Path of the Open Hand (violence on Jedha, pictured).]]
With it decided the [[Eirami]] and [[E'roni]] representatives would meet on the neutral ground of [[Jedha]] to form an official treaty, Chancellor Mollo allowed [[Morton San Tekka]] to oversee the discussions as neutral arbiter, deciding it would be better than sending a Republic official. However, the interference of the Path and Graf family member [[Tilson Graf|Tilson]] kicked off the [[Battle of Jedha]],<ref name="Battle of Jedha">''[[The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha]]''</ref> shattering any hope of a lasting peace between Eiram and E'ronoh.<ref name="THR (2022) 6">[[The High Republic (2022) 6|''The High Republic'' (2022) 6]]</ref> Rushing to Jedha after receiving a transmission from Sun about the collapse of the peace process, a group of Jedi and a [[platoon]] of [[Republic peacekeeping troop]]s shut down the battle.<ref name="Battle of Jedha" /> The Path was correctly suspected to be behind the carnage, but the Mother publicly blamed everything on rogue acolytes and attempted to clear her order's name by offering a minimum of one million [[Zukkel]]s towards rebuilding Jedha City. While the money was accepted, the revelation that a group like the Path had access to such funds caused the Republic to discreetly investigate, quickly discovering that the Mother had ties to wealthy individuals whom she had convinced to fund her cult.<ref name="Vengeance">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref>

After the Battle of Jedha, Axel was freed from prison by the Path of the Open Hand and brought to the [[Path compound]] on the planet [[Dalna]], where he was received by the Mother, who hoped to use Axel to leverage power over the galaxy through his connection with Chancellor Greylark. In the Mother's plan, Mollo, meanwhile, was going to be killed in a supposed accident as he traveled across the Rim.<ref name="Cataclysm" /> Nonetheless, the Mother rallied her followers against the Republic ahead of the looming [[Night of Sorrow|Battle of Dalna]], alleging that the Jedi lorded over the government and galactic media.<ref name="Vengeance" /> After Axel sent a message to his mother requesting her to come to Dalna as part of the Mother's plans, Greylark decided that she needed to support her son as a parent and understood that, should she arrive as Chancellor, the galaxy would be in danger. As such, she relinquished her position as Chancellor, leaving Mollo the sole leader of the Republic, much to his shock.<ref name="Cataclysm" />

In the name of investigating the Path, Jedi arrived on Dalna<ref name="Cataclysm" /> with the support of the Republic,<ref name="Out of the Shadows">''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]''</ref> which approved of the action and dispatched guards [[Priv Ittik]] and [[Lu Sweet]] to aid the Jedi. As the incident devolved into a battle, the Jedi would also be aided by anti-Path [[Dalnan]]s, but the Jedi were also faced by Force consuming creatures known as the [[Shrikarai|Nameless]]. In the end, Greylark arrived on Dalna to help her son, and the united militaries of Eiram and E'ronoh arrived in the name of defeating the Path after its efforts to divide them were uncovered. Although the reinforcements shut down the fighting, the high causalities of the battle, which ended with the Path even destroying its own caverns,<ref name="Cataclysm" /> resulted in it being remembered as a massacre<ref name="Out of the Shadows">''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]''</ref> dubbed the Night of Sorrow.<ref name="Mission to Disaster">''[[The High Republic: Mission to Disaster]]''</ref> From a certain point of view, the massacre had only happened because of the Jedi-Republic partnership,<ref name="Out of the Shadows" /> yet the Jedi and Republic's victory in the battle was seen as proof that partnership between both organizations made the galaxy stronger.<ref name="Cataclysm" />

[[File:PathOfTheOpenHandMembersSymbol-CharactersOfSWTHR.png|thumb|left|300px|The Mother of the Open Hand (center) led her cult (members pictured) against the Republic but failed to overcome the government and Jedi Order.]]
In the aftermath of the battle, Axel agreed to spend the time he owed in prison and revealed what he knew of the Path's internal workings, although the cult's membership had been shattered and fled across the stars.<ref name="Cataclysm" /> One of its major leaders, [[Guide of the Closed Fist]] [[Marda Ro]], escaped the destruction and set about on a new plan for revenge by forming the [[Nihil]],<ref name="Vengeance" /> with her plan being carried on by subsequent generations of the [[Ro family]].<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> Jedi Masters Crieghton Sun and Yoda also agreed to cover up all information on the Nameless until more details were discovered. Meanwhile, a new treaty was set to be signed by the now-cooperating peoples of Eiram and E'ronoh. Two weeks after the battle, a ceremony on the union of Eiram and E'ronoh and the opening of a new hyperlane was held on their shared moon by Mollo.<ref name="Cataclysm" /> At some point, the San Tekka clan lost Mari San Tekka to the Ro family, who used her to locate hyperspace [[Path]]s for their own revenge scheme.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

====The Starlight Beacon program====
{{Quote|In the days of the High Republic, the galaxy was not as settled as it is now. Areas like the Outer Rim were dangerous, hard to navigate. So the people of that time built a huge space station at great effort and expense and placed it in the center of the dark zones. It sent out a signal that acted as a sort of beacon, helping travelers find their way. They gave that station an inspiring name, fitting its purpose.|Grek|<ref name="SW 2">[[Star Wars (2020) 2|''Star Wars'' (2020) 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:TargonSoh.png|thumb|right|250px|Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh endeavored to unite the various peoples of the Galactic Republic.]]
In [[232 BBY]]<ref name="HR Announcement date">{{SWYouTube|xCat5fXRyyU|Star Wars: The High Republic | Announcement Trailer|sw_url=video/announce-trailer-star-wars-the-high-republic}} states that the events of [[Star Wars: The High Republic]] take place 200 [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[32 BBY]].</ref> the Galactic Republic was under the leadership of Supreme Chancellor [[Lina Soh]]<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> and Vice Chancellor [[Larep Reza]], who was a rising star in the Senate and thought to be Soh's apparent successor whenever her term came to its end.<ref name="Rising Storm" /> To showcase support for all species in its borders, the governmental motto became "We are all the Republic." Under Soh,<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> the Republic even began to take steps to curb its habit of indulging in bureaucracy when it needed to be instead taking action; even though the issue remained in a lesser form, the Republic took great steps in advancing beyond it.<ref name="Midnight Horizon">''[[The High Republic: Midnight Horizon]]''</ref> At some point the Republic intervened in the [[Soikan conflict|Soikan civil war]] to finally put a stop to the seemingly-endless conflict.<ref name="Mission to Disaster" />

Concurrent to its [[outreach program]], the Republic was in the midst of an era where all voices were listened to, creating governance from consensus and a society of culture, inclusion, ambition, and Soh's many [[Great Works]]. Among the earliest of these works—which encompassed everything from infrastructure projects to cultural affairs— was the ''[[Panacea]]'', a [[Salvation-class Republic medical frigate|''Salvation''-class Republic medical frigate]] that was deployed to help citizens after various crises; therefore, the [[frigate]] became a symbol of Republic's dedication to help its citizens. Other planned Great Works included a new treaty between the [[Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren]], the [[Republic Fair]], various communication relays, cementing the understanding of how to cultivate [[Bacta]], and various innovations in fields like technology. The greatest of the works was nonetheless [[Starlight Beacon]], which was planned to only be the first in a Beacon network that could truly bring the Republic out of the Core.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

[[File:RepublicFairPoster.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Republic's "Great Works" initiative saw the construction of distant outposts like Starlight Beacon.]]
Constructed along with other way stations at considerable expense and effort<ref name="SW 2" /> through many challenges over a long period of time,<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> Starlight Beacon was designed to expand the Republic's domain to the unexplored "dark zones" of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="SW 2" /> because Soh pledged to bring that region into the Republic's embrace, hoping the government could actually help the Outer Rim instead of simply flying through it or using it as another place to collect taxes. Beyond using its beacon to guide travelers and its relay to boost local transmissions by a factor of ten, the Beacon was a Republic embassy<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> within the Galactic Frontier,<ref name="Great Jedi Rescue">''[[The High Republic: The Great Jedi Rescue]]''</ref> that could serve many other purposes, being a fortress to discourage piracy, a place for cultural showcases, a state-of-the-art medical center, and, in part, a massive [[Starlight Beacon's Jedi temple|Jedi temple]]. The Jedi provided support to the Republic and its projects. The Jedi established outposts on many Outer Rim worlds, ensuring they could explore and protect those who lived without much of a Republic presence.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

Although the Outer Rim was hard to navigate and dangerous to live in,<ref name="SW 2" /> many poor settlers traveled to the region, leaving the overpopulated Core Worlds and Colonies in pursuit of new lives. These dreams for better lives were supported by the Republic, which—although imperfect like all governments—encouraged the hopes of its citizens, whether those hopes be large or small. Additionally, Soh wanted the people of the Republic to know that they all were part of the government, and the Republic began construction of Starlight Beacon to help with its expansion into the Outer Rim. The beacon was the symbol of everything Soh wanted for the Republic, being able to ensure it could truly expand from the Core to be a galactic government. Others in the government preferred the status quo, wanting to save credits in case of future issues, but Soh, having proved to her people the positive effect of coming together, pushed on with her works to bring the Republic into the Rim. Every Senator knew the success of Starlight would bring forth Soh's hopes that future generations could live in prosperity, while its failure would be massive.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

[[File:TheGreatDisaster.png|thumb|right|250px|Starships across the galaxy were thrown out of hyperspace in an event known as the Great Hyperspace Disaster.]]
Lacking a formal military due to the galaxy's peace, the Republic was protected by a small peacekeeping fleet known as the [[Republic Defense Coalition]], which was helped by the Jedi Order. Despite the large-scale partnership between them and Republic during the era,<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> there came to be some Jedi who doubted whether it was truly the will of the Force for them to act so closely with the government. Indeed, Jedi Master [[Cohmac Vitus]] believed it was a Republic and Jedi partnership that had led to the massacre on Dalna<ref name="Out of the Shadows" /> from over a [[Standard century|century]] prior.<ref name="Mission to Disaster" /> The partnership between the two parties would only increase when the [[Nihil conflict]] began;<ref name="Out of the Shadows" /> the conflict began when starships were abruptly knocked out of hyperspace in a galaxy-wide event known as the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]]<ref name="HR Announcement" /> caused by the [[Eye of the Nihil]] [[Marchion Ro]], a member of the Ro family who had destroyed the [[transport]] ''[[Legacy Run]]'' in hyperspace, which made its remains come out of hyperspace in the [[Hetzal system]], causing a sudden crisis as they rained upon the system. Beyond wanting revenge on the Jedi for secretive, family reasons, Ro had made his move to ensure the [[Nihil]] raiders could grow beyond what they were currently. With the Republic expanding into the Outer Rim, he knew they would need to change themselves to survive, launching his plot to ensure he could secure leadership over the raiders.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

[[File:FourJediTwoContractorsOneBox.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi and Republic rushed to the Hetzal system to save it from the Great Disaster.]]
The RDC deployed the [[Emissary-class Republic Cruiser|''Emissary''-class Republic Cruiser]] ''[[Third Horizon]]'' to the Hetzal system in response to the [[Hetzalian government]]'s [[distress signal]]. Aboard the ship, Jedi Master [[Avar Kriss]] was overseeing the effort, learning through her [[Song of the Force|Force network]] that some of the fragments raining upon the system contained living beings. She helped lead the effort to rescue the system's refugees and everyone aboard the fragments until she detected a large container of liquid [[tibanna]] threatening the system's [[R-class]] star. Kriss and the other Jedi used their combined focus to move the container with the Force, while the RDC continued to focus on evacuating the remaining refugees. The Jedi's effort to move the container was broadcast across the Outer Rim and into the inner Republic worlds by [[technician]] [[Keven Tarr]]; while he had at first only sent the signal to Chancellor Soh, he did not want his star system to be destroyed without being acknowledged, so the people of the Republic watched the Jedi effort. At first, the Force users failed, but their second attempt moved the container, saving Hetzal and resulting in cheers across the Republic.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

Although the Republic was able to learn the destruction of the ''Legacy Run'' had been the cause of the disaster, the government remained unaware of why it was destroyed, making Soh fear another disaster could happen in hyperspace. Additionally, the Republic was faced with the [[Emergences]]; these were when remaining fragments of the ''Legacy Run'', which were all continuing to travel throughout hyperspace, exited in an Outer Rim system, resulting in pieces raining down and destroying whatever they hit. The [[First Emergence]] was at the [[Ab Dalis system]], which was further along the same hyperspace route the ''Run'' had been traveling on, and these Emergences continued to spread. Thus, Soh feared the Republic could have to cease hyperspace travel, which would separate worlds and effectively end the galactic government. Additionally, the Nihil took advantage of the First Emergence, launching a [[Attack on the Garello convoy|raid]] on a [[convoy]] of ships carrying refugees. Nevertheless, because he had caused it, only Ro understood that they were directly responsible for the Great Disaster and its aftershocks.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

====Conflict with the Nihil====
{{Quote|I mean the Republic, building its Starlight Beacon out in my territory. Invading, taking over, with all its rules and laws and particular brand of freedom that isn't free at all. And you Jedi always just behind, absolutely convinced that every action you take is right and good. My family learned that to its cost, long ago.|Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro|<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />}}
Although it was a larger mobilization effort than anything done for sometime, Soh established an RDC [[blockade]] of various Outer Rim hyperspace routes, intending to protect starships from being destroyed in hyperspace by stopping that travel altogether. The blockade would ultimately be forced to grow as more systems were effected by the Emergences. As predicted by Senator [[Izzet Noor]], who served as the spokesperson in the Senate for the majority of the Outer Rim, the blockade brought strife, as many Rim worlds were not self-sufficient and depended on hyperspace for trade. During a meeting on Coruscant fifteen Emergences into the crisis, Soh had pledged to send [[supply ship]]s into hyperspace if a food crisis grew too dire, although the halting of the trade still had major negative effects for the Rim. During that same meeting, she established that the hyperlanes would remain closed, minus limited transport of essential goods, until they knew more about the crisis before noting she was unwilling to postpone the [[dedication of the Starlight Beacon]]; it was nearly finished, and she wanted to use the event to showcase a triumph over adversity.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

[[File:AuroraThreeAtKur.png|thumb|right|250px|The Great Disaster precipitated a conflict between the Republic and the Nihil in the Outer Rim Territories.]]
Survivors of the first Emergence and Great Hyperspace Disaster were taken to the yet-to-officially open Starlight for medical treatment. With Starlight due to open in thirty days, Soh gave that as the timeline to solve the Emergence crisis; she did not want to open the way station while the blockade was still ongoing, knowing it would appear as if the Republic could not protect its own people. Due to the blockade, the Nihil's craft became the only ships traveling at lightspeed, making Ro suggest they slow down operations—stating they could attract the attention of the Jedi or RDC—while also sowing the seeds for his takeover, approving the [[raid on Elphrona]] to ensure a Jedi would be captured. Meanwhile with the Republic, technician Tarr, having tracked the previous Emergences to form a pattern, began to construct a [[Keven Tarr's navidroid array|system]] of thousands of [[Nav droid|navigation droids]], hoping it could be used to predict where future Emergences would be and find the ''Legacy Run''{{'s}} [[black box]]. Assigned to learn more about the Emergences, Jedi Avar Kriss and [[Elzar Mann]] were also directed to meet with the San Tekka Clan on Naboo by Noor, yet [[Patriarch]]s [[Vellis San Tekka|Vellis]] and [[Marlowe San Tekka]] did not disclose any information about Mari, despite realizing her abilities could have caused the crisis and giving the Republic effort other aid.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" />

The [[Republic rescue fleet]] was dispatched to the planet [[Trymant IV]] in the wake of an [[Trymant IV disaster|Emergence]] and [[Attack on Trymant IV|Nihil attack]].<ref name="HRA 2">[[The High Republic Adventures (2021) 2|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2021) 2]]</ref> The Republic effectively assumed the Nihil were destroyed in the [[Battle of Kur]], but the marauders survived and began to launch their raids on a galaxy-wide scale, instead of remaining in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> The Nihil [[Valo Atrocity|attack on Valo]] was a major blow to the Republic, although it did give a chance for the Republic and Torgrutas to heal their relations.<ref name="Rising Storm" /> In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Grizal]], Republic forces rallied under Jedi Master [[Emerick Caphtor]] to [[Debacle on Vrant Tarnum|clear out]] a Nihil base on [[Vrant Tarnum]].<ref name="TOS 1">[[The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 1|''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 1]]</ref> Following the end of the [[Drengir crisis]], the Republic and Jedi were able to focus their efforts on defeating the Nihil through [[Operation: Counterstrike]],<ref name="Tempest Runner">''[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner]]''</ref> in which the Republic and Jedi moved to wipe out all known Nihil bases. However, the conflict also resulted in the Republic and Jedi growing closer together, with Chancellor Soh and her aides coming to insert themselves into even the Jedi Council's<ref name="Out of the Shadows" /> normally private<ref name="Episode I" /> meetings.<ref name="Out of the Shadows" /> In secret, the Nihil had also infiltrated the Galactic Senate via Senator [[Ghirra Starros]] and [[Jeni Wataro]], aide to Senator Noor.<ref name="Shadows Remain">{{InsiderCite|issue1=207|issue2=208|Starlight: Shadows Remain}}</ref> In [[200 BBY]],<ref name="VowDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates ''[[The Vow of Silver Dawn]]'' to [[200 BBY]].</ref> Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Sean]] remembered that the Nihil had launched an invasion of the Republic.<ref name="Vow">''[[The Vow of Silver Dawn]]''</ref>

====Expansion and stagnation====
{{Quote|With eyes toward expansion into the uncharted reaches of the Outer Rim, the traditions of the Core became passé. Opportunity beckoned from beyond the borders of the Mid Rim worlds.|Janyor|<ref name="SWP" />}}
[[File:Invest_Wisely.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Commerce guilds generated massive profits by investing in the Republic's expansionist policy.]]
The light and prosperity of the High Republic Era was fading<ref name="Launchpad 231">{{InsiderCite|231|Launchpad}}</ref> by [[132 BBY]]<ref name="AcolyteDate">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> and came to its final end around 100 BBY.<ref name="Timelines" /> Still, for centuries, the Galactic Republic had expanded not through force but by quietly exerting a strong magnetic pull towards neighboring systems. The promise of trade with [[Core Worlds|Core World]] markets held many systems in sway, inexorably luring non-member worlds into tighter cooperation with the state body. Despite this, the Republic remained slow to invite new systems into its fold, as the addition of new territories diminished the [[Politics|political]] power of existing senators. New member states invariably aligned themselves with local galactic power blocs, while most senators who gave the invitations represented systems in the Core. As a result, the Galactic Center represented the beating heart of the Republic that habitually drew wealth and power from the hinterlands, with most senators dismaying at the extension of services and protection to outlying worlds. Consequently, many useful star systems were left waiting—some for centuries—for the body politic to admit their world as a member of the Congress, even though it came at the cost of the body's overall power.<ref name="A New Dawn">[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']]</ref>

As time went by the Republic stood firm, becoming increasingly powerful. As a result, the galaxy remained free of any full-scale war for centuries. However, many of the [[bureaucrat]]s and [[senator]]s that ran the government continued to work for their own profit rather than the common good. Greed, corruption and internal strife slowly began destroying the government from within.<ref name="RepublicDB" /> The Core, revitalized from the destructive conflicts of the past and ravenous for new resources to exploit, embarked on an aggressive colonization policy, exploring, mapping, and settling untouched planets within the Outer Systems, striking deals with or simply overrunning the indigenous populations that stood in their path. Adventurous pioneers found themselves granted permission by Coruscant to settle new territories and establish trading colonies to feed the Core with the goods and raw materials for its continual self-enrichment. Many new systems, finding themselves lacking the funds to mine, process, and ship their products to market, were forced to secure high-interest loans from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], whereupon many, unable to repay their debts, found themselves as mere client worlds to the [[Muun]] bankers. As time progressed, the laborious task of astrogating by [[hyperwave beacons]]—which required numerous reversions to [[realspace]]—became simplified with the founding of new [[Hyperspace route|hyperlanes]], such as the [[Hydian Way]]. Many systems, eager to benefit from the opportunities offered by charting hyperlanes through their system, sought to influence the Republic Senate to put themselves on the galactic map.<ref name="Tarkin" />

[[File:SenateDistrict-POP.png|thumb|right|250px|The peoples of various worlds were influenced by Coruscanti culture and Republic architecture during the reign of the Galactic Republic.]]
Culturally, [[Coruscanti]] fashion, art, drama and literature saw receptive audiences across the galaxy. Seeking to impress visitors from the Core, many worlds sought to build lavish mansions that imitated the [[Republic architecture|architectural style]] of the Inner Core. Despite this, many Coruscanti looked with disdain on what was in reality nothing more than a gaudy impersonation. To them, these lifeforms on the galaxy's fringes appeared barbaric, with most worlds still lacking weather control or struggling with geological disturbances and food shortages. Additionally, many outlying worlds, lacking the protection of a federal military found themselves continually harassed by numerous [[pirate]]s and criminal organizations, further ingraining the long-held view that those from the galaxy's outlying settlements lacked cultural refinement and basic civility.<ref name="Tarkin" />

A deep-rooted hatred and distrust grew over the centuries between the galaxy's outer fringes and the cosmopolitan Core, with those in the hinterlands gradually coming to believe themselves the victims of social and economic injustices. As a result of the perceived inability of the Judicial Forces in protecting outlying territories, who were often withheld in intervening after many far-flung worlds refused to provide the Core Worlds with profitable deals, the Outer Rim world of [[Eriadu]]—one of the most politically, culturally and economically developed worlds—formed the [[Outland Regions Security Force]] for the protection of the [[Seswenna sector]]. Comprising an amalgam of ships, it was funded primarily by off-world loans and supplied with [[laser]] and [[ion cannon]]s acquired from arms merchants who had for centuries been ignoring a Republic ban on the sale of weaponry to member worlds. While the Outland Regions Security Force at first lacked success, it soon came to be renowned for its efficiency at dealing with raiders, especially after [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] was accepted into Outland's anti-piracy task force, in which he was known for outsmarting and outmaneuvering his opponents.<ref name="Tarkin" />

[[File:Galactic_Senate.png|thumb|left|250px|The Galactic Senate was mired in political corruption during the Republic's final years.]]
Despite Outland's best efforts, the Outer Rim Territories continued to fall victim to increasing corporate interests from the Core, with the monolithic [[Trade Federation]] expanding its reach in both the Outer Rim and the Galactic Senate by utilizing loopholes in existing free-trade legislation.<ref name="Tarkin" /> By [[42 BBY]],<ref name="42BBY">''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' dates the [[incident on Serenno]] to [[42 BBY]]. Dooku's speech in the [[Galactic Senate]] occurs at the same time according to ''Dooku: Jedi Lost''.</ref> the Republic was expanding at an unprecedented rate, yet that expansion was largely due to the Federations' interests.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost">''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]''</ref> While a faction known as the [[Militarists]] emerged in the Senate with hopes of establishing a formal Republic Military at some point,<ref name="Rise of the Separatists" /> the Senate voted to cut the [[Republic Security Force]]'s trade route defense program, citing cost concerns as the Federation was unwilling to pay whatever taxes would be incurred to pay for the Republic Guard program. Jedi Master Dooku implored the Senate to reconsider, but his objections were shouted down by Senator [[Bulgeski]]—whom Dooku would point out had previously called on the Republic Guard for the protection of his own world, [[Salliche]]—and the Federation's representative. [[Chancellor]] [[Skor Kalpana]]—who was characterized by Senator [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] as a good, yet also weak, man—also rejected Dooku's suggestion.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

Shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo]], a [[Eriadu Conference|trade summit]] was held on the Outer Rim planet of Eriadu in which Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum]] was turned away by Wilhuff Tarkin, who was hoping to reduce the influence of the Chancellor who some already expected to lose the next election in order to support Senator Palpatine, who had earlier helped Tarkin gain entrance into the Judicial Academy and supported his ascension as [[Governor of Eriadu]].<ref name="Tarkin" />

===Invasion of Naboo===
{{Main|Invasion of Naboo|Supreme Chancellor Election, 32 BBY}}
{{Quote|It is clear to me now that the Republic no longer functions. I pray you will bring sanity and compassion back to the Senate.|Padmé Amidala, to Sheev Palpatine|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
[[File:Sith_Lords_Trade_Federation.png|thumb|right|250px|The Sith orchestrated the Invasion of Naboo by controlling the leaders of the Trade Federation.]]
Despite the best efforts of the well-meaning Chancellor Valorum,<ref name="sweVA">{{SWE|characters|valorum|Supreme Chancellor Valorum}}</ref> the Trade Federation [[blockade]]d Naboo over disputes about [[plasma]] exports. A Judicial force carried Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the ''[[Saak'ak]]'', a Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] to discuss a peaceful resolution to the conflict.<ref name="Tarkin" /> [[Darth]] Sidious, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]], ordered [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] to invade Naboo ahead of schedule, and to kill the Chancellor's Jedi [[ambassador]]s. [[Theed]], the capital city of Naboo, was swiftly occupied by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]]. The Jedi, having survived the Federation's efforts to kill them, [[Escape from the Saak'ak|escaped]] to Naboo where they rescued [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and her entourage.<ref name="Episode I" />

Amidala undertook a journey to Coruscant to plead her [[homeworld]]'s case to the Senate, but the damage to the [[Naboo Royal Starship]]'s [[T-14 hyperdrive generator]] necessitated a detour to the remote world of [[Tatooine]] for repairs. Acting on Gunray's report, Sidious instructed his [[Sith apprentice]], [[Maul|Darth Maul]], to locate and reacquire the [[queen]] as only she had the authority to sign a treaty making the Federation's occupation of Naboo legal. Although Maul tracked them to Tatooine, he failed to prevent the Jedi from escaping with Amidala on her repaired starship. In addition, Jinn took custody of an emancipated slave child, [[Anakin Skywalker]], whom he found to be exceptionally strong with the Force. Believing that he had found the prophesied [[Chosen One]], Jinn brought Skywalker to Coruscant to begin his [[Jedi training]].<ref name="Episode I" />

[[File:Amidalabeforesenate.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Queen Amidala's Vote of No Confidence was instrumental in Senator Sheev Palpatine's rise to power.]]
Senator Palpatine and Chancellor Valorum greeted Amidala upon her arrival to the capital. Though Valorum assured her of the Senate's distress over the situation, Palpatine warned her that neither the Senate nor the Chancellor were likely to intervene unless they made a change in leadership. As Naboo's galactic representative, Palpatine served as Amidala's advisor and confidant. He told her that the Senate was corrupt, and the Chancellor a figurehead to the bureaucrats. When the Trade Federation's delegates forced Valorum to adhere to bureaucratic procedure, Amidala countered by calling for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in him, following Palpatine's advice despite her initial reluctance to denounce a strong supporter of her world.<ref name="Episode I" />

Believing the Republic no longer adhered to its founding principles, Amidala returned to her planet to liberate the [[Naboo (people)|people of Naboo]] without the Senate's intervention. Before leaving Coruscant, Palpatine informed her of his nomination to succeed Valorum. His competitors were Senator [[Bail Antilles]] of Alderaan and Senator [[Ainlee Teem]] of [[Malastare]], but Palpatine assured Amidala that he would win the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY|election]] through widespread sympathy for Naboo's plight. He vowed to dedicate his term to ending corruption, and Amidala implored him to restore compassion to the Senate.<ref name="Episode I" />

[[File:Naboo_celebration.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The victors of the Battle of Naboo celebrated their triumph in the liberated city of Theed.]]
Unable to count on Republic aid, Amidala turned to Naboo's [[Gungan]] population. Despite ill feelings between their segregated societies, the occupation of their shared homeworld allowed Amidala to mend their relationship through diplomacy. The [[Gungan Grand Army]] confronted the Trade Federation's [[battle droid]]s while the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] launched an attack on the ''Saak'ak'' in orbit. The Gungans were forced to surrender after their defenses collapsed, and several [[Naboo Fighter Pilot]]s were killed in the space battle. However, Amidala's team infiltrated the [[Theed Royal Palace]] where they captured Gunray, and with the ''Saak'ak'' destroyed by Skywalker, the droids were deactivated. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Naboo]], Gunray was taken into Republic custody and the newly-elected Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine arrived in Theed where he and the queen congratulated each other on their recent success. The new Chancellor said that they would work together bringing peace and prosperity to the Republic.<ref name="Episode I" />

===Separatist Crisis===
{{Main|Separatist Crisis}}
{{Quote|I will not let this Republic that has stood for a thousand years be split in two. My negotiations will not fail.''"<br />"''If they do, you must realize that there aren't enough Jedi to protect the Republic. We're keepers of the peace, not soldiers.|Sheev Palpatine and Mace Windu|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
[[File:2000_Senators_propaganda.png|thumb|left|200px|The Separatist Crisis reflected widespread disillusionment with the Republic.]]
Following the Naboo Crisis, the Trade Federation monopoly on the Outer Rim was broken, all while Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum's political standing suffered from the crisis along with other scandals. In his wake, Palpatine was appointed to the position of Supreme Chancellor, eventually creating an image of himself as a mild-mannered servant of the common good, despite his true intentions. However, growing tensions between the Core and Outer Rim worlds gradually increased to the point where many believed that a war was imminent.<ref name="Tarkin" /> Foreseeing this conflict years before the Invasion of Naboo, Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]] advocated for the creation of a new Republic army, only to be rejected by the [[Jedi High Council]], who believed his ideas too extreme. Undeterred, Sifo-Dyas contacted the [[Kaminoan]]s, known for their [[Cloning|clone]] hatcheries, and secretly commissioned them to create a clone army, pretending to represent the Galactic Senate. Unbeknownst to Sifo-Dyas, Darth Sidious had earlier contacted [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]], and convinced him to implant a [[behavioral modification biochip]] into the clones during the third stage of their development to turn against the Jedi at a mere command.<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>

[[File:Dooku-GhostsOfTheMachine.png|thumb|right|250px|The former Jedi Master Dooku led the Separatist movement against the Republic.]]
The dashing swordsman and political idealist Jedi Master [[Count]] [[Dooku]], taking an eight-[[Standard year|year]] leave of absence from the Jedi Order and now secretly the apprentice of Darth Sidious and dubbed Darth Tyranus,<ref name="Episode II" /> paid the [[Pyke Syndicate]] to eliminate Sifo-Dyas over the planet of [[Oba Diah]]. With Sifo-Dyas originally heading to the planet in order to negotiate a dispute that could have resulted in a full-scale gang war on Coruscant, Sifo-Dyas was suddenly re-assigned to [[Felucia]] when his shuttle was abruptly shot down over the planet. Bringing his body to Felucia, where it was cremated by tribal inhabitants, Dooku managed to trick the Jedi Council into believing Sifo-Dyas had been killed by the Felucians,<ref name="The Lost One" /> all while erasing the existence of [[Kamino]] from the [[Jedi Archives]].<ref name="Episode II" />

In the decade after the Invasion of Naboo, the whereabouts of Count Dooku were scarcely known, with many believing he merely wished to form an offshoot of the Jedi Order. In reality, Dooku manipulated galactic events to foment political turmoil on a variety of worlds, including [[Kashyyyk]], [[Sullust]], and [[Onderon]]. Seeking to create a southern Separatist sphere of influence by bringing [[Yag'Dhul]] and [[Sluis Van]] to his side, Dooku needed to persuade the now prosperous world of Eriadu to join the Separatists. However, Wilhuff Tarkin was pressured to declare his loyalties especially after Dooku commandeered a [[HoloNet]] station in the [[Raxus system]] and denounced the Galactic Republic, effectively setting the stage for the [[Separatist Crisis]]. Tarkin ultimately sided with the Galactic Republic in his stern belief that an inefficient yet unified galaxy was better than a fractured one.<ref name="Tarkin" />

[[File:JarJarDestroysTheRepublic-AotC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Senate granted the chancellor emergency powers at the behest of Representative Jar Jar Binks.]]
Chancellor Palpatine's negotiations with the Separatists were unsuccessful, leading the Galactic Senate to consider the [[Military Creation Act]]. Senator Amidala led the opposition against the bill, believing it would make war between the Republic and the Separatists inevitable. Following an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]] on Amidala, the chancellor ordered her to return to Naboo while the Jedi [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)|investigated]] the plot against her. [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] assumed her responsibilities on Coruscant for the duration of Amidala's absence. The Jedi's subsequent discovery of two secret armies, the clones and the [[battle droid]]s, influenced the Senate's next actions. The [[Loyalist]]s agreed that the Republic needed the clone army, yet they felt that the Senate would fail to pass the Military Creation Act before the Separatists' attacked the Republic with their [[droid]] forces. When [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]] suggested that they resolve the crisis by bestowing emergency powers to Chancellor Palpatine, Representative Binks proposed as much to the Senate who passed his bill, allowing Palpatine to officially recognize the clone army as the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. A self-proclaimed proponent of democracy and Republic patriot, Palpatine assured the senators that he intended to return the powers that they had given him after the crisis was over.<ref name="Episode II" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Main|Clone Wars}}
{{Quote|I have to admit that without the clones it would not have been a victory.''"<br />"''Victory? Victory, you say? Master Obi-Wan, not victory. The shroud of the dark side has fallen. Begun, the Clone War has.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
[[File:Clone_Army_Charge.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Battle of Geonosis was the first battle in the Clone Wars.]]
The Clone Wars began with the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. Supported by the [[Republic Navy]], the Grand Army of the Republic engaged the [[Separatist Droid Army]] in the open field. The Jedi joined the battle as well,<ref name="Episode II" /> acting as ''de facto'' generals for the clone troopers.<ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Meanwhile, [[Poggle the Lesser]]'s schematics for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Ultimate Weapon]] were transferred to Dooku who escaped the battle after [[Lightsaber duel|dueling]] Skywalker, Kenobi, and [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]]. Simultaneously, the various members of the newly-founded [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] evacuated the planet as Republic clone [[trooper]]s gradually forced the droid army into full retreat. The battle was hailed as a Republic victory, although Yoda took the opposite position as he knew that war would spread across the galaxy. Count Dooku traveled to an [[The Works|industrial sector]] on Coruscant to inform his master that the war had begun as planned, all while the Jedi High Council pondered Dooku's warning that the Dark Lord of the Sith controlled the Senate.<ref name="Episode II" />

In the aftermath of the Battle of [[Geonosis]], the deadly three-year conflict that engulfed the galaxy in chaos officially began.<ref name="TSWB" /> Though suspicious of Dooku's claim that the Senate was under the Sith's influence,<ref name="Episode II" /> the Jedi continued to serve the Republic. The [[military rank]] of [[Jedi General]] was created,<ref name="Mace Windu 1">[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 1|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 1]]</ref> allowing the Jedi to lead the Grand Army of the Republic in an official capacity.<ref name="TSWB" /> Early into the war, Sidious learned of a splinter faction in the Trade Federation under the Neimoidian [[Oje N'deeb]], who wanted to usurp Gunray and give the Outer Rim a chance for a new future. While initially outraged and considering crushing the rebellion outright to ensure the Federation and the legacy it would leave behind stayed true to his plans, Sidious quickly realized he could use the upstart to his advantage; if N'deeb's operation was turned to his own ends, the Outer Rim would be strengthened by N'deeb's faction, but that work would only serve to prolong the war. Once the "chance" N'deeb offered the Rim was crushed, furthermore, Sidious understood that its people who feel even more bitter towards the Republic.<ref name="QH">''[[Queen's Hope]]''</ref>

[[File:AnakinAndNautolanJediTeamUp-AORPadme1.png|thumb|left|250px|With the galaxy in a state of war, the Jedi became generals in the Grand Army of the Republic.]]
The worlds that were caught in the middle of the conflict were forced to choose sides between the Galactic Republic and its clone army or the ever-expanding Confederacy of Independent Systems and its droid army. With the war well under way, numerous diplomatic envoys engaged in several attempts to sway local worlds to join the Galactic Republic, with Jedi Master Yoda seeking to win the support of the [[Toydarian]] [[King]] [[Katuunko]], while [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] sought to disrupt the meeting, and instead sought to win the support of the king to join the Confederacy.<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> The Republic also sent military aid and support to factions in need, such as [[Cham Syndulla]]'s [[Twi'lek Resistance]] on [[Ryloth]],<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> or to the [[Dug]]s of Malastare, whose lucrative fuel reserves were a great boon to the Republic Navy.<ref name="The Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> Numerous worlds such as [[Mandalore]] also attempted to maintain their neutrality, although they often were forced to seek aid from third parties in times of need.<ref name="Episode II" /><ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />

Throughout the Clone Wars, numerous attempts were made against Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's life, including an kidnapping attempt on Naboo masterminded by Count Dooku<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> as well as the hostage taking of members of the Galactic Senate by notorious bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> However, political intrigue fueled not only the conflict, but also advances in weaponry and the development of equipment to enhance existing armed forces. Attempts at biological weapons were launched by Separatist scientist [[Nuvo Vindi]], who attempted to re-create the ancient [[Blue Shadow Virus]] capable of killing millions across the galaxy,<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> while the Republic developed the experimental [[electro-proton bomb]], which could send out an electric pulse upon detonation capable of deactivating an entire droid army.<ref name="The Zillo Beast" />

[[File:ZilloBeastBreaksFree-ZBSB.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic transported a Zillo Beast to Coruscant after the Battle of Malastare.]]
Following the [[Battle of Malastare]], the Republic also attempted to create an impenetrable armor by unlocking the biological secrets of the [[Zillo Beast]], an ancient creature from the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]], only to have the attempt end in failure, sending the beast on a [[Zillo Beast incident|rampage]] across Coruscant. After its death at the hands of a Jedi task force, the beast was secretly cloned by orders from the Supreme Chancellor himself.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref> In the meantime, the Republic developed a [[IPV-2C Stealth Corvette|stealth ship]] capable of cloaking itself, as well as upgrading its standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] to the more sophisticated [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] prior to the [[Battle of Mon Cala]].<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>

[[File:Hostage-SWL.png|thumb|left|200px|Republic clone troopers were the military arm of the Galactic Senate.]]
The Republic adopted the clone army to defeat the Separatists, but the clone troopers were also at the disposal of the Senate. The [[Coruscant Guard]] was formed by [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock troopers]] stationed on the Republic capital;<ref name="CoruscantGuard">{{Databank|coruscant-guard|Coruscant Guard}}</ref> senatorial delegates were accompanied by clone bodyguards;<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" /> and the clones became involved in the Republic's internal disputes by acting as enforcers of the Senate.<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> The Senate Guard still accompanied dignitaries on off-world missions,<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref> but as the war continued the Coruscant Guard became increasingly responsible for the security of the Supreme Chancellor<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" /> and the delegates of the Senate.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

On one occasion, the Republic deployed a Jedi-led force of clone troopers to [[Orto Plutonia]] at the behest of one of its members, the [[Pantoran Assembly]]. The government of [[Pantora]] claimed sovereignty over the planet, which resulted in [[One-Day War|open conflict]] between the [[Pantoran]]s and the native [[Talz]]. Although the clones served under the Jedi, they were also beholden to the authority of the Pantoran leader, [[Chairman]] [[Chi Cho]], and the Pantoran senator [[Riyo Chuchi]].<ref name="Trespass" />

===Fall of the Republic===
{{Quote|Too late, for what? The Republic to fall? It already has, and you just can't see it! There's no justice, no law, no order except for the one that will replace it!|Maul|<ref name="PhantomA">{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}}</ref>}}
[[File:TempleSmoke-Sabotage.png|thumb|250x250px|The Jedi Temple was the site of a terrorist attack against the Order.]]
The Grand Army of the Republic was led by Jedi Generals throughout the Clone Wars.<ref name="TSWB" /> While many heroic actions were taken by the Jedi and the troopers under their command, inspiring the public with stories of bravery, war weariness only continued to grow as the years went by.<ref name="A New Dawn" /> The Republic citizenry grew to believe that the Jedi had abandoned their role as peacekeepers,<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> and staged massive protests outside of the Jedi Temple as a result. Despite their waning influence in the galaxy, the Jedi continued to lead the Republic's forces but sustained many casualties in the process. Their role in the conflict was opposed not only by civilians,<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> but also the [[Republic officer]] Wilhuff Tarkin who wanted to revoke the Order's military authority, convinced that the [[Jedi Code]] was a hindrance on the Republic war effort.<ref name="Counterattack">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>

Padawan [[Barriss Offee]] also disagreed with the Order's involvement in the Clone Wars, and staged a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] in the Jedi Temple as protest, all while framing [[Ahsoka Tano]] of committing the act before being captured herself.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref> The [[Shadowfeed|Separatist Shadowfeed operation]], an attempt by Count Dooku to spread information on Republic defeats, making it appear as though a Separatist victory was inevitable, fueled public anxiety and consequently accelerated the militarization of the Republic over the course of the war.<ref name="Tarkin" /> Palpatine painted the picture of military victory over the CIS being the only way to lead the galaxy to peace, justifying the expansion of the Republic Military in the process.<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

[[File:PalpatineRedGuard-TWJ.png|left|thumb|250x250px|Chancellor Palpatine's wartime powers made him a dictator in all but name.]]
The war also served as a means for Palpatine to amass more emergency powers, cementing his position as Supreme Chancellor far longer than it technically allowed, all while continuing to centralize political and military authority within the [[Office of the Chancellor]], which included putting the InterGalactic Banking Clan under the Chancellor's oversight.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" /> By gaining wartime powers, Chancellor Palpatine was effectively a [[Dictatorship|dictator]].<ref name="Darth Sidious DB">{{Databank|emperor-palpatine-darth-sidious|Emperor Palpatine/Darth Sidious}}</ref>

Palpatine used the war as his reasoning for amending the Galactic Constitution multiple times, enshrining greater power in his office through his changes.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> He became the most powerful chancellor since before the [[Ruusan Reformations]].
